newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian Vilnius Bank makes comeback on bourse.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian Vilnius Bank makes comeback on bourse.

text.p: Shares in leading Lithuanian bank Vilnius Bank made their first trade after a recent share split on Wednesday, registering a price of 140 litas, dealers said.

The bank recently split the nominal value of its shares to 50 litas from 500 litas. Before the split it had been trading around the 1,300 litas level. Turnover in its stock today was some 163,800 litas.
Elsewhere, the market was thin as the group A index of the bourse's most active stocks slipped 117.99 points to 1,255 and overall central market volume was 720,000 litas.
Shares in Hermis Bank continued to be active, rising to 145 litas from 143 litas on trade of 290,000 litas.
Bloc trades worth 275,000 litas were carried out while the volume of the secondary T-bill market reached 112,000 litas.
